name: lognook
description: A generic local log writer and web viewer for Node.js.
author: 7pou.com@mail.com

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:lib
scripts.test: pnpm run test:lib && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:bundle: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.bundle.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:lib && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:types: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target es2023 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --types node tests/package-types.mts
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:bundle && pnpm run test:types
